findings.body: A new `endpoint: String` field is added to `ExternalTtsProvider` and the constructor now expects an `endpoint` argument (see the inserted `let endpoint: String = endpoint.into();` and the field initialization). Existing code that creates an `ExternalTtsProvider` without providing this argument will fail to compile, causing a regression. Callers must be updated to pass a suitable endpoint value or the struct should provide a default/optional value.
findings.existing_code:
pub struct ExternalTtsProvider {
    slug: String,
    endpoint: String,
    default_voice: String,
    api_style: TtsApiStyle,
    client: ExternalTtsClient,
findings.title: Add required `endpoint` field breaks existing constructors

value.summary: The change adds an `endpoint` field and logs speech transfers, but it introduces a breaking API change that will require all callers of `ExternalTtsProvider::new` to supply an endpoint argument, potentially causing compilation failures if not updated.
